title: Only 70 Breeding Right Whales Remain
closing: Every surviving mother now carries an enormous share of the species' future.
question: Can right whales still recover?

segments.say: Right whales number only 384. A small town still outnumbers the entire species.
Right whales produced 22 calves this season. New births finally offer a fragile sign of recovery.
Only 70 right whales are breeding females. Losing even a few can slow recovery for years.
